Pair event displays

Selected pair candidates from run_145, sub-run stat090_0000, on the is2_v2 re-pass reconstruction at the capsule-focus angle scale (kA 1.103, kC 1.081). Each loop opens on a close view of the pair, orbits the whole set-up, and comes back. The panels on the right show raw strip charge against drift depth, with the fitted track dashed over it. The events

What is drawn

  • TPC charge: raw DREAM waveforms (decoded_root, pedestal and common-mode subtracted, samples above 5σ), not the hit tables. A strip plane measures (strip, time), so in 3D each view is drawn as a projection on its own chamber face: x strips on the top face, y strips on the side face. A sample at time t sits at depth (t − 140 ns − t₀) · v/k, where 140 ns is the bundle's pulse peaking time.
  • Tracks: the stage-3 lines. They are thick inside the 30 mm gap, run out to the SiPM wall, and run back to the pair's closest approach (black dot).
  • Scintillators: wall groups (4 bars each, all the read-out resolves), plastics and LS slabs with an in-time hit (−100…+60 ns, not the control collection) are lit.
  • Capsule: the pose2 fit, 15 mm toward −x, 10 mm low, top tilted 10° toward φ 135°, beam centred at x = −10 mm (radius 22 mm). The sideways position is degenerate with the beam's; the one drawn is the best-χ² member of that family.

What these displays do not show

  • They are hand-picked from one sub-run (1/29 of run_145), chosen to be clean. They illustrate the topology; they are not a sample of it. The rates are the pair analysis's numbers (SAME_CHAMBER_PAIRS.md), not these.
  • A same-chamber "wall2" pair needs two particles, but not two from one vertex. Two-arm pairs near 180° are mostly single through-going particles.
  • The angle scale is the capsule-focus k, 12 % above the in-beam muon scale (open). At the muon k every opening angle shrinks by about that much.
  • Stage 3 here was rebuilt on the laptop with build_tracks.build_arm from the is2_v2 reco. The wall match and pair flags are det_a_scint.match_run and det_a_intra.pairs, unchanged, but the table is not the desktop's stage3_is2_v2_cf file.
